# Instructor guide · Topic 16: Trie

<!-- generated by tools/export-docs.mjs from topics/ and questions/: do not edit by hand -->

## Learning objectives

Store words as shared prefix paths, and answer insert, search and prefix queries in time proportional to the word length.

By the end of the topic, students can:

- **Prefix trees:** A trie stores words letter by letter.
- **Building one:** Each node holds a dict of children and an end flag.
- **Prefix problems:** Autocomplete, replacing words with their roots, counting prefixes and wildcard search are all a walk down the trie followed by a look at what is below.

## Duration and prerequisites

- Lessons: about **30 minutes** of guided material (3 lessons)
- Practice: 8 coding problems and 17 quick questions in the bank; plan at least as much practice time as lesson time
- Suggested format: one 90-minute session
- Prerequisites: Topic 13 (Trees), Topic 6 (Hash Tables)

Open the topic in the browser (`#t/trie`) and project it; every lesson alternates a short explanation with questions the class answers together.

## Live coding demonstrations

- A compact trie (lesson “Building one”)
- Brute force → optimal walkthrough: **Autocomplete: scan every word → walk a trie** (Challenge tab). Code the brute force, ask students to find the repeated work, then refactor.
- Visualizers to drive while students predict the next step: Trie: insert, search, prefix search

## Questions to ask the class

Ask, wait for several answers, then reveal (the answers are on the topic's Review flashcards).

- Trie node holds…
- Insert/search cost?
- search vs starts_with?
- When a set is enough?
- Autocomplete?

## Classroom exercises (individual, 10–15 minutes each)

- Longest Common Prefix (`tr-lcp`)
- Count Words With a Prefix (`tr-count-prefix`)

Code tracing on the board: A trie made of dicts (`tr-p1`), How many nodes? (`tr-p2`), Prefix is not a word (`tr-p3`), Inserting “tea” (`tr-dr1`)

Find-the-bug warm-ups: Prefixes count as words (`tr-d1`), Inserting erases words (`tr-d2`)

## Pair programming (25–30 minutes)

One driver types, one navigator thinks ahead and checks edge cases; swap every 10 minutes.

- Replace Words (`tr-replace`)
- Search Suggestions (`tr-suggest`)
- Build from scratch: Build a Trie (`build-trie`)

## Homework

- Word Dictionary With Wildcards (`tr-wildcard`)
- Longest Word Built Letter by Letter (`tr-longest-word`)
- Word Search II (`tr-word-search`)
- Finish the topic's Review quiz in the browser and clear the revision queue.

## Solutions and grading

- Reference solutions: `solutions/16_trie/` (also behind “Show solution” in the browser).
- Students check their own work with `python dsa.py test <id>`; collect `pytest tests/test_my_solutions.py -k trie` output as evidence.
- Grade with the coding rubric in [README.md](README.md#grading-rubrics).
